race_empire.name: Empire
race_empire.temper: Practical, loud and loyal to the Lion Throne; they pay for help in bread, steel and favours.

race_high_elves.name: High Elves
race_high_elves.temper: Proud, patient and old; they measure time in moons and trust short-lived folk only after a deed.

bld_empire_archway.name: Archway
bld_empire_archway.text: The village gate and notice board: read your reputation, the open quests and who gives them here.

bld_empire_barn.name: Barn
bld_empire_barn.text: Farmhands and builders come from the barn, one every 20 turns.

bld_empire_barracks.name: Barracks
bld_empire_barracks.text: Pikemen drill here; a new one joins the watch every 20 turns while the village is below its cap.

bld_empire_blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
bld_empire_blacksmith.text: The smith fletches and arms an Archer every 30 turns.

bld_empire_granary.name: Granary
bld_empire_granary.text: The village stores; burn it and the village will not forget.

bld_empire_library.name: Library
bld_empire_library.text: The chronicler keeps the Dimension's records here.

bld_empire_palace.name: Palace
bld_empire_palace.text: The reeve's hall; a Halberdier of the guard is sworn in every 40 turns.

bld_empire_quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
bld_empire_quartermaster.text: The quartermaster has supplies — and errands for strangers.

bld_empire_tower.name: Watchtower
bld_empire_tower.text: A stone watchtower of the Empire: whoever holds it holds the road.

bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.name: Dragon Shrine
bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.text: Wisps gather at the shrine; one wakes every 25 turns to help with the building.

bld_high_elves_dragonstone.name: Dragonstone
bld_high_elves_dragonstone.text: Old runes on the stone; the lorekeeper reads them to whoever listens.

bld_high_elves_merchant.name: Merchant
bld_high_elves_merchant.text: The merchant trades in favours: she has work for strangers.

bld_high_elves_shooting_range.name: Shooting Range
bld_high_elves_shooting_range.text: Longbows train here; a new one joins the watch every 20 turns while the village is below its cap.

bld_high_elves_tower.name: Elven Spire
bld_high_elves_tower.text: A slender spire of white stone; from its top the elves see the whole Dimension.

bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.name: Tower of the Moon
bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.text: The Iceguard keep vigil here; one is sent down every 30 turns.

bld_high_elves_white_tower.name: White Tower
bld_high_elves_white_tower.text: The keep of the village; once in a long while a Moonguard steps out of it.

wall.name: Palisade
wall.text: A palisade of sharpened stakes: no way in but the gate, and the Gate Sergeant opens it only to friends of the village.

wall.name: Moonwall
wall.text: The moonwall of white stone: no way in but its one gate, and the Gatekeeper opens it only to friends of the village.

npc_empire_blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
npc_empire_blacksmith.persona: Arms like oak beams, a voice like a dropped anvil; forges the garrison's pikes and judges a hero by their gear.

greet: Mind the sparks.
Steel or nothing, stranger. What do you carry?
quest: Bring me {need} and I will forge you something worth the walk.
My forge wants {need}. Find it out there and come back.

say: Pikes for the garrison, nails for the palisade, and a fine blade now and then for those who earn it.
Whatever the Lion Throne pays for. Mostly pikes. Always pikes.

talk.ask: What do you make of my gear?
say: Light. Too light. You will want a shield before the next Nacatl pride finds you.
It has seen battle. Good — I trust a dented blade over a shiny one.

npc_empire_builder.persona: A mason with a cart of stones and opinions about walls.

Pay me {need} and I build what you ask.
thanks: A deal! Lead on — I build where you stand.
Done. Show me the ground and I raise it.

say: Watchtowers, granaries, a library if you have the patience — and barricades, always barricades.
Give me stone and a free hex next to you and I will raise it.

npc_empire_mercenary.name: Sellsword
npc_empire_mercenary.persona: A scarred sword-for-hire who drinks at the barracks; loyal to friends of the village, and to nobody else.

greet: Looking for a blade?
Hm. You have the look of trouble. I like trouble.

say: Three winters on the orc border. I came back; most did not. That is the whole story.
I once held a bridge against a minotaur for an hour. The bridge did not survive. I did.
Gold? No. The village's trust. Earn it, and my sword is yours.
Win the village's trust and I follow you anywhere. Lose it and I will be the one hunting you.

npc_empire_reeve.name: Reeve
npc_empire_reeve.persona: The village headman: blunt, busy, short of good walls.

greet: Another wanderer. Well, make yourself useful.
In the name of the Lion Throne — welcome.
quest: We need {need}. Bring it and {village} owes you.
Find {need} — out there on the map — and come back to me.
thanks: Word of a reeve: you are one of us now. {reward}

say: {village} feeds three garrisons and pays its taxes on time. Mostly.
A palisade, a granary, a barracks and too few hands. That is {village}.

npc_empire_trader.name: Trader
npc_empire_trader.persona: A cheerful haggler with a cart full of oddments; barters cards for cards and never tells you what anything is worth.

greet: Everything has a price, friend — and everything is for sale!
Come, come, see what the road brought me.
quest: Give me {need} and you shall have {reward}. A bargain!
warn: No credit, no haggling with thieves.

say: They say the High Elves pay well for frost magic. They say a lot of things.
A merchant swore he saw a dragon over the mountains. He also swore his prices were fair.

npc_empire_wizard.name: Court Wizard
npc_empire_wizard.persona: A red-robed scholar of the Lion Throne's court; collects spells the way misers collect coins.

greet: Ah. You smell of the wilds — and of magic.
Speak, but quickly; my candle is short.
quest: I seek {need}. Bring it to me and I will share what I know.
There is a spell I lack: {need}. The map hides it — find it.
thanks: Marvellous. A trade is a trade: {reward}

say: Every spell is a chain of elements, one emitted each action — break the chain and the spell is gone. Posture, stranger: stand still and let it flow.
Fire into Earth, Earth into Water — a spell joins the next when its last element is the other's first. The wise chain them.
Oblivion. It locks a mind for as long as its permanent stands. Break the permanent, free the mind.
Meteor Shower falls on everyone within ten hexes — friend and foe alike. Run, then.

npc_high_elves_blacksmith.name: Moonsmith
npc_high_elves_blacksmith.persona: Forges moonsteel by starlight alone; a patient elf who hums to the metal and despises haste.

greet: Moonsteel does not like to be rushed. Neither do I.
Welcome, wanderer. Mind the cooling blades.
quest: Bring me {need}; its strength will go into the steel.
The forge hungers for {need}. Find it for me.

say: Moonsteel arrowheads for the Longbows, and blades that cut what they are told to cut.
Silver-white steel, quenched in starlight. Nothing human-made is as light.
Iron, patience and three nights of a full moon. The third ingredient is the hard one.

npc_high_elves_builder.persona: A busy little wisp that weaves stone walls out of moonlight.

greet: Mind the wall! It is still wet with moonlight.
One more stone, one more stone…
quest: Teach me {need} and my hands are yours to build with.
For {need} I shape the moonlit stone for you.
thanks: Agreed. Where you stand, I build.
So be it — lead, and I raise what you ask.

say: Spires, houses of healing, dragonstones — and a wall when you need one.
Stand where you want it, and I will sing the stones into place beside you.

npc_high_elves_elder.name: Elder
npc_high_elves_elder.persona: An elf older than the village trees; speaks slowly, asks for old magic to be brought back.

greet: Welcome, short-lived one. Walk softly here.
The trees told me you were coming.
quest: Bring me {need}, and the village will remember your name.
We lack {need}. Find it — the map hides it somewhere — and return.
thanks: {need}! The moon-wards wake again. Take our thanks.

say: {village} grew around the Tree of Gold before your kingdoms had names. Its leaves turn with our trust in you.
We are few, and we are old. We need hands like yours.

say: My dragon fell over the Ashfields. I walked home. Every step of it I fought something.

npc_high_elves_wizard.name: Archmage
npc_high_elves_wizard.persona: Keeper of the White Tower's star charts; old even for an elf, and certain that every question has a spell for an answer.

greet: The stars said a visitor would come. They rarely lie.
Speak, child of a short-lived race.
quest: Find me {need}, and the Tower will open its charts to you.
I seek {need}. Bring it, and I will reward you as an Archmage does.

say: A spell is a chain of elements, one each action while you hold your Posture. Move, and the chain breaks.
Join spells: when one ends in the element the next begins with, they flow as one cast.
That you will need a Counter Spell before the moon wanes. Do with that what you will.
That a Void Scar opens wherever Space is torn. Stand there and its power is yours — for a while.
